description: This PHP class 'ApiAuthorizationSubscriber' functions as an event subscriber within a Symfony-based application, mainly to handle authorization on API endpoints and respond with appropriate 403 Forbidden responses when access is unauthorized.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber that handles authorization for API endpoints, checking user permissions and managing ForbiddenException responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events the subscriber listens to, with priorities.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks the controller and API permissions; throws ForbiddenException if unauthorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException by returning a standardized JSON error response with HTTP 403 status.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to permission getter methods like 'canRead' or 'canCreate'.
